returns-v1.title: DemoStore returns policy (fictional)
returns-v1.quote: For this fictional store, unopened items may be considered for return within 14 days of delivery. A support reviewer must assess each request. The assistant cannot approve returns or issue refunds.

shipping-v1.title: DemoStore shipping policy (fictional)
shipping-v1.quote: For this fictional store, standard delivery is estimated at 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Estimates are not guarantees. Order-specific information must come from the authenticated order lookup.
